content.text: Skip to main content Advertising CloseAd : 00Volume Mute Miami Dolphins quarterback Dan Marino career highlights | NFL Legends Miami Dolphins Hall of Fame quarterback Dan Marino led his franchise for 17 seasons, during which he broke all-time NFL records for touchdown passes, passing yards, and completions - among many others. Despite never leading his team to a Super Bowl title, Dan Marino will be remembered as one of the greatest QBs to ever play the game.
